sloka: यस्माल्लोकत्रयं चैतद्रावितं भयमागतम् ।तस्मात्त्वं रावणो नाम नाम्ना राजन्भविष्यसि ।। ७.१६.३८ ॥
transliteration: yasmāllokatrayaṁ caitadrāvitaṁ bhayamāgatam ।tasmāttvaṁ rāvaṇo nāma nāmnā rājanbhaviṣyasi ।। 7.16.38 ॥

translations.english: Because the three worlds were made to cry out and fear came upon them due to your roar, therefore, O king, you shall henceforth be known by the name Ravana.
